technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple RSI periods, stochastic bearish cross, and MACD weakness create significant pullback risk; entry timing is poor despite bullish directional bias.

fundamental.summary: AFL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 72 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity from junior member, neutral market fear/greed, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (255.5) indicates extreme market stress, with earnings 72 days away providing moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX confirms strong trend structure with price above all major moving averages and bullish OBV, providing directional conviction despite overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI 9/14/21, stochastic bearish cross, MACD downward crossover, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, zero fundamental support) create unacceptable pullback risk with poor entry timing.

decision.entry_rationale: Do not enter. Bear case dominates with score 9 vs bull 3; extreme overbought technicals (RSI 21 extreme, stoch bearish cross, MACD down) combined with zero fundamental support and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) create unacceptable risk-reward.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment at crisis levels (VIX 255.5, inverted yield curve) with earnings event 72 days away; overbought technicals and bearish MACD crossover signal imminent pullback into deteriorating macro backdrop.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; technical overbought, fundamental absent, sentiment neutral, macro severe, debate decisively bearish
